title: Range Additions
statement:
Use a difference array to apply all inclusive range additions in O(n+q).

Input
Read n q, the n initial values, then q updates L R x with 1 ≤ L ≤ R ≤ n.

Output
Print the final n values in index order.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000, 0 ≤ q ≤ 200000. Initial values and x have absolute value at most 10⁹.
